caption_L1: This is a area graph labeled Gross domestic product (GDP) per capita in Belgium from 2007 to 2017 , by region (in euro purchasing power parity). The y-axis measures Flemish Region on a linear scale of range 0 to 40,000. The x-axis shows Year.
caption_L2L3: The year with the lowest GDP output in the Flemish Region of Belgium was 2009. The year with the highest GDP output was 2017. Apart from 2008-2009, all other years show an increase in GDP output. From 2010 onwards, GDP output increases at a steady rate.
